desc: Designed for quiet operation, run the dryer without interrupting naptime or your favorite show. With Sensor Dry, the dryer can detect moisture and automatically adjust drying time for loads of all sizes—saving energy with less wear and tear on clothes.
hl: Designed for quiet operation, run the dryer without interrupting naptime or your favorite show.
ELIMINATE THE GUESSWORK WITH SENSOR DRY
With Sensor Dry, the dryer can detect moisture and automatically adjust drying time for loads of all sizes—saving energy with less wear and tear on clothes.
WHO SAYS DRYERS CAN’T BE E-EFFICIENT?
High efficiency sensor drying and low-heat settings save energy and money by using about 20% less energy than conventional models without sacrificing performance.
GET IT ALL DONE IN LESS TIME
Free up your day—fit more clothes in every load with Ultra Large Capacity (7.4 cu. ft.).
FLEXIBILITY TO FIT ALMOST ANY SPACE
This dryer is worth showing off, but when space dictates otherwise it’s good to know it'll easily fit in almost any closet with plenty of room to close the closet door.
KEEP YOUR DRYER CLEAN, EFFICIENT & SAFE
With the FlowSense® Duct Clogging & Clean Filter Indicators, you'll know when it's time to clean the ducts and lint filter to ensure great drying and lower utility bills.
